dataset.name: climate.csv - GHCN-Daily US weather-station records (1970-2023)
dataset.original_source: NOAA NCEI Global Historical Climatology Network - Daily (GHCN-Daily); Menne et al. (2012), J. Atmos. Oceanic Technol. 29, 897-910
dataset.licence: None declared on the Hugging Face mirror; original NOAA GHCN-Daily is US-Government public-domain data (citation of Menne et al. 2012 requested)
dataset.access: Free - no registration (as recorded in the Dataset Catalogue)

problem.target_meaning: next-day maximum temperature at the same station (deg C)

environment.run_location: local Jupyter on Windows 11 laptop (16 GB RAM)
environment.note: Driver memory lowered from 6g to 4g and temp files moved to E: after Java out-of-memory crashes

artefacts.not_in_git: data/, lakehouse/ and models/ are excluded by .gitignore (too large); they are rebuilt by the notebook

provenance: All values are copied from the outputs of notebooks/task1.ipynb (run of 17 Oct 2026) and results/task1.json. No values were estimated or invented.
